## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive; mixed sector picture (Energy/Healthcare/Communication positive vs Technology/Industrials weak) and broad leadership supporting a neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare strong: JNJ (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND; Communication advancing: META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Energy 8/10 positive, Healthcare 11/17 positive, Communication 6/10 positive.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials weak: HON (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -16.07%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND; Materials and Technology under pressure with AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Industrials 4/15 positive, Materials 3/11 positive, Technology 8/24 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND; TMUS (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND; TTWO (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -8.85%) BELOW TREND; PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Communications names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W momentum: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present — multiple large caps (GOOGL, AMZN, WMT, UNH) show 1W up vs 1M down (RECOVERY), so treat momentum as tactical not a clear market trend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak: AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +4.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND, while AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND and PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND drag. Sector breadth: Technology 8/24 positive — internal rotation with leadership bifurcation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed but holding up: JPM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +2.96%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +2.67%) CORRECTION; PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND is an outlier. Sector breadth: Financials 11/20 positive — selective strength but not broad participation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Constructive: JNJ (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +11.62%) ABOVE TREND, NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND while LLY (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare 11/17 positive — defensive ballast with selective cyclicals within pharma/biotech.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Neutral stance: favor trimming exposure to names showing broad tech/industrial weakness and favor selective exposure to Energy and high-quality Healthcare names; style: mixed / no clear leadership given bifurcated Tech and Energy moves. Monitor RECOVERY cases (GOOGL, AMZN, WMT) for confirmation before rotating core allocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: 8/10 positive; 1W: +4.22%) and Healthcare (Breadth: 11/17 positive; 1W: +1.09%). BEARISH: Industrials (Breadth: 4/15 positive; 1W: -2.58%) and Technology (Breadth: 8/24 positive; 1W: -1.40%).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND for hold above recent highs as confirmation of Tech resilience; AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND — monitor pullback to weekly support for re-accumulation cues; JPM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND — watch for breakout above short-term consolidation to validate Financials strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (+85): headline takeover chatter; PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price weak (distribution/divergence). ABBV (+65): positive Phase 3 news (cross-ref price showing strength in Healthcare clusters) — ABBV not a top performer this week but catalyst confirms sector interest. PLTR (+50): deal expansion headlines; PLTR showing positive intra-week response (monitor for follow-through).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TTWO (-45): leak/concerns; TTWO (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -8.85%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. AMD (-50) / INTC (-45): sector-level caution around semi cycle; AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND confirm semiconductor capex stress.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and select Healthcare names are showing strength (VLO ABOVE TREND, MPC ABOVE TREND, JNJ ABOVE TREND). Key risk is the major divergence across large caps (multiple RECOVERY cases) — monitor news-driven moves (PYPL takeover chatter vs price) for confirmation.
